tasks.label: hapi-diag-status
tasks.command: docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml ps; docker inspect cobhrm-hapi --format "RestartCount={{.RestartCount}} Status={{.State.Status}} ExitCode={{.State.ExitCode}}"; docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml logs --tail=120 hapi

tasks.label: hapi-probe-endpoints
hapi-log-finish-check
tasks.command: docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml logs --tail=80 hapi | findstr /I "Started Application Tomcat started ERROR Exception"

tasks.label: hapi-probe-powershell
tasks.command: try { $m = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/fhir/metadata' -Method GET -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "metadata=$($m.StatusCode)" } catch { Write-Output "metadata=ERR $($_.Exception.Message)" }; try { $h = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/actuator/health' -Method GET -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "health=$($h.StatusCode)" } catch { Write-Output "health=ERR $($_.Exception.Message)" }

tasks.label: hapi-log-markers
tasks.command: $logs = docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml logs --tail=120 hapi; $logs | Select-String -Pattern 'Started Application|Tomcat started|ERROR|Exception|HAPI-1298'

tasks.label: hapi-failure-search
tasks.command: $logs = docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml logs hapi; $logs | Select-String -Pattern 'Application run failed|Unable to start web server|HAPI-1298|Package ID|Caused by' | Select-Object -Last 40

tasks.label: hapi-restart-after-name-fix
tasks.command: docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans; docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml up -d; docker inspect cobhrm-hapi --format '{{.RestartCount}} {{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}}'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 12; docker inspect cobhrm-hapi --format '{{.RestartCount}} {{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}}'; $logs = docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml logs --tail=120 hapi; $logs | Select-String -Pattern 'HAPI-1298|thePackageId must not be blank|Application run failed|Unable to start web server|Started Application'

tasks.label: hapi-readiness-probe-loop
tasks.command: $ok=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 90;$i++){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/fhir/metadata' -Method GET -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output "ready status=$($r.StatusCode) attempt=$i"; $ok=$true; break } catch { if($i % 10 -eq 0){ Write-Output "waiting attempt=$i err=$($_.Exception.Message)" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if(-not $ok){ Write-Output 'not-ready-within-timeout'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: hapi-current-phase
tasks.command: docker inspect cobhrm-hapi --format '{{.RestartCount}} {{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}}'; docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml logs --tail=200 hapi

tasks.label: hapi-final-restart-verify
tasks.command: docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans; docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml up -d; Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; docker inspect cobhrm-hapi --format '{{.RestartCount}} {{.State.Status}} {{.State.ExitCode}}'; $logs = docker compose -f hapi-testing/docker-compose.yml logs --tail=160 hapi; $logs | Select-String -Pattern 'HAPI-1298|thePackageId must not be blank|thePackageVersion must not be blank|Application run failed|Unable to start web server|Started Application'

tasks.label: hapi-metadata-ready-check
tasks.command: $ok=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 120;$i++){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/fhir/metadata' -Method GET -TimeoutSec 6; Write-Output "ready status=$($r.StatusCode) attempt=$i"; $ok=$true; break } catch { if($i % 15 -eq 0){ Write-Output "waiting attempt=$i" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if(-not $ok){ Write-Output 'not-ready-within-240s'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: hapi-metadata-once
tasks.command: $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/fhir/metadata' -Method GET -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "status=$($r.StatusCode) len=$($r.Content.Length)" } catch { Write-Output "err=$($_.Exception.Message)"; exit 1 }

tasks.label: hapi-verify-autoversion-start
tasks.command: cmd /c hapi-testing\stop-hapi.bat; cmd /c hapi-testing\start-hapi.bat; powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/fhir/metadata' -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output ('status=' + $r.StatusCode)"
